from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A document in the collection: its title and the titles of papers it cites found in the text."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cited_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers found in this document's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
